Do you enjoy romcoms?Do you know that Parents of the Year, a book by an Indian author, Pratik Harsh, has made it to the Frankfurt Book Fair? Yes, you heard that right. The book has been selected for one of the world's most prominent international book fairs, where it is set to make its international debut. But that's not the only milestone this book has achieved. Parents of the Year is a contemporary rom-com set in Mumbai revolving around Ishu and Neeti, a high-powered couple whose demanding careers have left them desperately in need of a rest. At its heart, the book brings together romance, humour, corporate burnout, life-work balance, and of course, plenty of canine chaos. It has been featured in the Times of India and is also currently showcased at the Gomti Book Festival. It has also been selected for the Mumbai Book Fair, taking place from 24th to 29th of October. And now, Frankfurt, from being a story written from an Indian author to finding its way to an international literary platform, that's quite a journey. And there's more to look forward to. So if you're someone who loves discovering contemporary Indian authors before their stories travel even further, Parents of the Year is definitely a book to put on your radar.
